answer: ﻿Each identity earns a jade token only by solving a unique puzzle bound to its key — a velvet constraint that cannot be shared: the solution fits one lock and no other. A raven farm running a thousand clones must solve a thousand puzzles; at four seconds of CPU per puzzle, that is over an hour of serial work before the first alias can vote. One honest agent solves once and compounds freely; the farm bleeds time proportional to its size.
